notes: C16 (blockers/INTEGRATION_BLOCKERS.md): UKG UltiPro renders a personalized 'Featured opportunities' block of ~20 US recommendation anchors sharing the origin, path_prefix, depth and ?opportunityId=<uuid> shape of the real results. Captured WITH suppression active, which is mandatory rather than stylistic: the featured set is personalized and drifts independently of the real results, so freezing it would guarantee a flaky count. job_board_url is the ArcGIS-geocoded Costa Rica pre-filter (w/wc/we/wpst) because the WhereInput autocomplete is not a native <select>; hooks.filter_already_applied=True guards it against C11-shape agent re-toggle. expected_unfiltered_count=10 therefore equals expected_jobs: the URL baseline IS the filtered view (Confiz/Svitla precedent), not the full board. path_prefix is pinned to the /OpportunityDetail route so matching runs through the id-in-query branch; the derived prefix would also admit sibling chrome such as /Accessibility at the same depth.
